releaseNotes: Keeps Notes active after deleting an individual note by intercepting the delete action before the legacy handler can navigate away
Separates Pen and Marker option groups so changing a Pen setting cannot reveal Marker controls and changing a Marker setting cannot reveal Pen controls
Text uses only the stable text-format toolbar; eraser has no redundant option row
Preserves the hardware-confirmed fullscreen mode from 0.12.27 and all editor/autosave behavior
